target.name: radical-liberal ATProto client
target.behavioralScope: visual-only; preserve existing constitutional and provider semantics

decisions.decision: Use structured semantic roles; retain old bg/panel/ink names only as boundary aliases.
decisions.reason: The live products share values but not naming; semantic roles prevent component coupling to a product-specific palette.

decisions.decision: Use #b189ff for dark accent text where required and a separate #7787e8 dark selection fill.
decisions.reason: Idoldle and the historical accessibility review distinguish accent text from selection; blog and sorter retain the older #9c68ff role.

decisions.decision: Use #4d5372 for new light-mode muted text.
decisions.reason: Sorter and Idoldle use contrast-corrected values; the blog comment records #5e6480 as an older public palette value.

decisions.decision: Use Page Mode for social content and Workbench Mode for services, identity, personalization, moderation, and diagnostics.
decisions.reason: The living products share a culture rather than one shell; game framing and research-pane geometry must not be copied into every screen.

decisions.decision: Keep the ATProto network mark; do not substitute the Edriffles emblem.
decisions.reason: ECW is a design language and the actual actor/product must remain accurately attributed.
